Yes, that's clear. Clicking the "architecture" label on a card narrowed the library down to just the links filed under that topic, so it's obvious what I'm looking at. That's the "click a label to see everything under it" thing I wanted from the very start.

And the sidebar organization feels right to me — having all my labels gathered on the left with a little count next to each is handy, because I can see at a glance how many links sit under each topic and jump straight to one from there. Being able to click a label either from the card or the sidebar is nice; I'll use whichever's in front of me.

One small thing to confirm: once I'm filtered down to a label, how do I get back to seeing everything? I'd expect something obvious — like clicking "All bookmarks" at the top of the sidebar — to clear the filter and show my whole library again.
